item.title: Anthropic IPO meets AI backlash after midterms show stinging rebuke of data centers
item.description: Anthropic is poised to become the first pure-play AI company to hit the public market at a time when the public is increasingly leary of the industry.

item.description: President Donald Trump offered the job of press secretary to UFC president and CEO Dana White on Saturday.

item.description: The U.S. and Iran are on a collision course as tensions in the Middle East simmer.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway more than doubles buybacks in third quarter as earnings decline
item.description: Berkshire Hathaway said Saturday it accelerated its share repurchases during the third quarter, as operating and overall profits took a hit.

item.title: Trump targets Slotkin in call for DOJ probe of alleged Democratic threats to Republicans
item.description: Trump ordered DOJ to examine alleged threats against Republicans while singling out Slotkin.

item.title: America doesn't like socialism. So why are socialists winning?
item.description: Democratic socialists had their best showing yet at the polls. The problem: Most U.S. voters don't actually like socialism.

item.title: Berkshire shares surge as Wall Street swoons amid AI fears

item.title: Trump says U.S. carried out ‘minor strikes’ on Iran as missiles hit Qeshm Island
item.description: Trump said the U.S. carried out ‘minor strikes’ on Iran after Iranian media reported two missiles hit Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Mark Cuban says he doesn’t ‘give a f---' about growing his net worth—a healthy mindset for non-billionaires too, a financial therapist says
item.description: The billionaire serial entrepreneur says he cares more about the impact he can have by spending and investing, rather than worrying about amassing more wealth.

item.title: 31-year-old dumpster diver brought in $140,000 in 12 months: I 'did much more than I thought was possible'
item.description: Carter Stevens started reselling discarded items from dumpsters around Nashville, Tennessee, in March 2024. Months earlier, he'd been living in his car.
